shared_recipe.target_modules_semantics: All linear layers of the text-generating backbone. For a multimodal wrapper this excludes the unused vision tower and is recorded as language-linear in the architecture-specific training manifest.

host_selection.evidence_validation_amendment: Bind exact dev corpus rows, recompute ranking metrics from prediction/score rows, and register the observed LFM legacy manifest schema. No ranking metric, direction, tie breaker, or model was changed.
host_selection.raw_referee_tie_breaker_clarification: The existing development Referee-validity tie-breaker is evaluated on the directly usable raw generation: raw_sbn == true and (raw_clf_referee if recorded else clf_referee) == true. The postprocessed Referee rate is retained only as a diagnostic. The metric priority, direction, remaining tie-breakers, and models are unchanged.
host_selection.target_module_manifest_contract_correcti: Register the exact architecture-specific manifest representation of the already-frozen shared policy: legacy all-linear for LFM, structured all-linear for Granite, and all language-backbone linear modules with the unused vision tower excluded for Qwen. This corrects fail-closed evidence validation after all baseline outputs but before any host was selected; it does not change adapters, logits, outputs, metrics, ranking rules, or models.
host_selection.purpose: Select one frozen LoRA host for the publication-scale U/B/W/BF/WF method experiment without test-set selection.

method_experiment.execution_schedule_amendment: Keep the integrity pilot and all layer/beam diagnostics development-only; generate held-out test and tax publication/intervention artifacts only after every development artifact is frozen. The method, populations, metrics, and resource ceiling are unchanged.

layer_ablation.note: Generate only the missing B/W cells, then hash-preservingly merge them with the pilot U/BF/WF rows. This yields an unbiased first-400 layer ablation without regenerating existing conditions.

fine_grained_ablation.note: Generate only S/R/G after host selection and join them byte-for-byte with the independently gated dev400 U/B/W/BF/WF artifact. This tests grammar-only, reference-register, graph, semantic, and finite-budget contributions without regenerating existing cells. The design was frozen after Granite optimization diagnostics but before any Granite task metric was read.

beam_selection_study.motivation_source: Primary-source audit of Fancellu et al. (Findings EMNLP 2020), Liu (LREC-COLING 2024), Grammar-Aligned Decoding, and Draft-Conditioned Constrained Decoding
beam_selection_study.postw_selection: highest-sequence-score U beam candidate accepted by W; fall back to U top-1 when no W-valid candidate exists
beam_selection_study.note: This is a matched-budget diagnostic of offline well-formed beam selection versus online dynamic-state and finite-horizon intervention. It is deliberately separate from the frozen greedy primary matrix and runs only after that matrix.

conditioned_intervention.selection_criterion: configuration == U and (raw SBN invalid under B or semantic state invalid under W)
conditioned_intervention.reporting_scope: mechanism attribution and repair/regression counts only; never use conditioned validity as a population estimate

paired_statistics.wellformed_valid_definition: raw_sbn == true and (raw_clf_referee if recorded else clf_referee) == true
paired_statistics.multiplicity: Holm within each binary metric across comparisons
paired_statistics.note: All deltas are constrained minus U on identical IDs and decode settings. Timing intervals reflect variation across examples, not repeated-system measurement noise. Failure-conditioned intervention populations are mechanism analyses, never population estimates.

method_experiment.note: The pilot is an implementation-integrity gate, not a performance-selection gate. Full paired evaluation proceeds after correctness checks regardless of whether the effect is positive or negative.

models.note: The official checkpoint contains a 4B language backbone plus a vision encoder. Text-only SBN training loads the published wrapper for exact weight mapping but injects LoRA only below model.language_model.
